text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I arrive at last! The one and only Gold Ship!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Glad to have you on board! We shall sail across the seven seas and discover the eighth ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: But first, there are quests to complete! And I'll be banking on ye to look up strategy guides and see which races drop ship mats!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
